combo.description: E into your enemies then use your Q and Flash before sending them all to sleep with your R. Then just as they wake up, hit them with your W and Q combo to finish.
Q Flash into an enemy team and then press R and Zhonya's Hourglass.
Lead with your E then R your enemy. Then use your Q and Flash to get onto your enemy, AA them and finish them off with your W.
Hit your target from range with your E and then press your R. Then W onto your enemy and Q them to burst them down.
Start with an AA, Q and AA. Then W, AA, E, AA, AA and Q again to finish the combo.
Lead with your E then W onto your enemy and finish off with a fadeaway Q!
